Class FirestoreImportPayments

public class FirestoreImportPayments
extends FirestoreService.ImportRecordsLogic

Extends FirestoreService.ImportRecordsLogic to process payment records from Firestore. Handles payment imports including currency conversion, Stripe processing fee calculations, customer information harmonization, and refund/adjustment creation for international and domestic transactions.

protected override FirestoreService.ImportRecordsResult execute(String jsonBody)

Processes payment records from Firestore API response, creating Payment2__c records with currency conversion and Stripe fee calculations, along with associated Adjustment__c records for refunds. Handles date range filtering, customer information harmonization (name, phone, email), and refund allocation across subtotal, tip, and tax.

Parameters:
    jsonBody – JSON string containing payment data from Firestore API in BlazeBitePayments format

Returns:
    FirestoreService.ImportRecordsResult: Result object containing imported Payment2__c and Adjustment__c records, completion status, and next page token

See Also:
    FirestoreService.ImportRecordsLogic.execute(String)
